tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Free. Returns every agentdatafeed dataset with record count, last update, price per query, filters and links. Call it first to choose a dataset, then use get_sample to inspect records or query_dataset for filtered data. When to use each dataset: amsterdam-events: Use when a user asks what is on in A

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free. Returns 5 real, current records from one dataset so you can check fields and quality before paying. Takes no filters: for records matching a date, place, vendor, country or keyword, use query_dataset.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Paid data access. Returns no records itself: it builds the HTTPS query URL for your filters and returns the x402 payment terms (USDC on Base; amsterdam-events $0.005, security-advisories $0.003, vulnerability-watch $0.003, eu-tenders $0.01, uk-tenders $0.005, eu-funding $0.005, cert-advisories $0.00

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Free. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, query_dataset · Private data: list_datasets, get_sample, query_dataset · Public sink: query_dataset, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, query_dataset · Private data: list_datasets, get_sample, query_dataset · Public sink: query_dataset, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
